# Third-party browser libraries

Guidelume serves its Markdown parser and sanitizer from this directory. The files
are unmodified upstream distributions; their copyright headers and full license
texts are retained beside them.

| Library | Version | License used here | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Marked | 18.0.5 | MIT; accompanying Markdown attribution retained | https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.0.5 |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.18 | Apache-2.0 (upstream also offers MPL-2.0) | https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify/v/3.4.18 |
